title: UI review
description: Coordinate scoped design extraction/reporting, design review, accessibility, UI quality and evidence checks.
intent: Review the requested screens or journeys for project fit, visual/system coherence, interaction usability, and supported accessibility evidence. Do not redesign or change source by default.

assignments.task: Establish critical journeys and a representative route/component/state/viewport/theme coverage matrix; inspect project design sources and reference behavior.
Map relevant current tasks, transitions, context persistence, and recovery against the requested coverage without redesigning or editing.
assignments.when: The UI review includes navigation, forms, or an end-to-end journey.

assignments.task: Capture the agreed interface/source evidence and produce the requested design/taste/candidate-system report in the authorized output directory as 1 artifact writer. Preserve source/runtime/image distinctions, evidence and unknowns; do not edit product truth or copy restricted assets.
assignments.when: The request explicitly includes extracting a design language/system, a taste profile/index, or a design reference report.

assignments.task: Independently review the extracted report against raw evidence and accepted scope in a fresh session when supported, without inheriting author conclusions. Retain the original review, triage findings and recheck accepted changes; do not approve candidate identity by default.
assignments.when: The requested extraction/report requires independent design interpretation review.

assignments.task: Review component/browser regression and accessibility automation evidence, assertion quality, and failure handling; do not claim unexecuted manual checks.
Review measured UI responsiveness, layout stability, bundle/startup, or interaction budgets with existing tooling.
assignments.when: The scope includes responsiveness, layout shift, asset loading, or documented UI performance budgets.

assignments.task: Validate measurement provenance, contrast/target/reflow claims, coverage, and distinctions between screenshots, source evidence, and actual interaction checks.
Independently walk through covered tasks and report evidence-linked friction, dead ends, confusing actions, and recovery defects.
assignments.when: The scope includes meaningful interactions or task journeys.

assignments.task: Assess covered states using declared criteria, actual keyboard/assistive checks where available, and interpreted automation; retain manual gaps.

completion: The coverage matrix ties findings to relevant states, viewports, themes, and source/runtime evidence.
Contrast and other criterion findings use measured values and applicable exceptions; uncertain checks stay unverified.
The final prioritized report separates system divergence, usability defects, and optional visual preferences.
Requested extraction reports trace values and profile interpretations to captured evidence, identify candidate artifacts and omitted/unchecked scope, and do not silently replace project identity.
